title: Checkbox
summary: A checkbox drawn from tokens, with an indeterminate state and select-all groups: a master checkbox mirrors every checkbox of its group.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: The mixed state (some of a group are checked).

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: group
props.description: Puts this checkbox in a select-all group of that name.

props.name: master
props.description: Makes this the select-all checkbox of the group of that name; it shows checked, unchecked or indeterminate as its members change.

props.name: size
props.description: sm is the compact checkbox of a toolbar: smaller label text.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-change
events.description: The user changed the value (same moment as change; carries it).

parts.name: control
parts.description: The label wrapper (the whole row is the tap target).

cssProperties.name: --pk-checkbox-gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the box and its label.

a11y: A native checkbox inside its label, so it is named by its text and toggled by Space; indeterminate is announced as mixed; invalid sets aria-invalid and a red border. Rows are 44px tall on a phone.

examples.title: States
examples.html:
<pk-checkbox checked>Track inventory</pk-checkbox>
<pk-checkbox>Include archived</pk-checkbox>
<pk-checkbox indeterminate>Some variants selected</pk-checkbox>
<pk-checkbox disabled>Disabled</pk-checkbox>
